evidence: The film thickness was measured by EPMA. The XPS analysis showed that the films contain 0.3 mass% of Cl. The structural investigations by RHEED demonstrated that the TiO film deposited on GaAs in 100 cycles is perfectly amorphous. The XRD data characterizing the latter film, however, did not reveal any crystallinity. The AFM observations showed that the topography of the areas between the surface particles of the 3000-cycle film is similar to the topography of the films the growth of which was interrupted at considerably less advanced stages. The quantitative information resulting from AFM and EPMA measurements was used to determine the proportion of the crystalline phase in the films. The film deposited in 10,000 cycles on the quartz substrate showed that the polycrystalline anatase part was large enough to be observed in XRD experiments.
